title: User Fairness, Item Fairness, and Diversity for Rankings in Two-Sided Markets
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and algorithmic formalization of fairness and diversity in ranking systems. While it addresses 'fairness' as an objective, it treats it as a structural and economic optimization problem within two-sided markets (using a movie recommendation dataset) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, theology, moral reasoning, or ethical traditions.
